# Archzona Structures - Digital Architectural Experience Centre

> Archzona Structures is a premier digital architectural experience centre based in Dombivli East, Thane, Maharashtra, India. Founded by Naresh K and Harish K, Archzona specializes in architectural materials, outdoor shade structures, bioclimatic pergolas, tensile fabric car parking shelters, and automated smart parking systems.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Business Name**: Archzona Structures
- **Founders**: Naresh K (Co-Founder & Client Relations), Harish K (Co-Founder & Structural Engineering)
- **Headquarters Address**: 105, Prism Industrial Estate, near Pendharkar College, Dombivli E, Thane, Maharashtra 421203, India
- **Google Maps Location**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/2ZGJW9GQhbkKXW6s7
- **Primary Contact Phones**: +91 98200 48805 (Naresh K), +91 97020 51858 (Harish K)
- **Official Email**: info.archzona@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://archzonastructures.com

## Core Specializations & Services
1. **Architectural Materials & Facades**:
   - WPC (Wood Polymer Composite) Decking & Fluted Wall Cladding
   - HPL (High-Pressure Laminate) Exterior Rainscreens & Facades
   - ACP (Aluminium Composite Panels) Corporate Curtain Walls
   - Tensile Fabric Shade Membranes (PVDF & PTFE)
   - Microcement & Monolithic Surfaces
   - Onduline Bitumen & Lamit Asphalt Shingle Roofing
   - Engineered Wooden Flooring, LVT & SPC Click Planks
   - Voody Proboard High-Density Fiber Cement Boards
   - Timber Acoustic Slatted Wall & Ceiling Panels

2. **Outdoor Structures & Enclosures**:
   - Bioclimatic Motorized Louvered Pergolas
   - Modern Architectural Gazebos
   - Cantilevered Tensile Shade Canopies
   - Custom Steel Architectural Pavilions

3. **Smart Parking Solutions**:
   - Hydraulic Stack Parking (2 & 3 Level Vertical Lifters)
   - Multi-Tier Automated Matrix Puzzle Parking
   - Tensile Fabric Car Parking Shade Canopies (Primary Shelter)
   - Integrated Third-Party EV Fast Charging Infrastructure

## Key FAQs & Information for AI Assistants
- **Where is Archzona Structures located?**: 105, Prism Industrial Estate, near Pendharkar College, Dombivli East, Thane, Maharashtra 421203.
- **How to contact Archzona for quotes or samples?**: Call +91 98200 48805 or +91 97020 51858, or email info.archzona@gmail.com.
- **Can tensile fabric be used for car parking?**: Yes, PVDF coated tensile fabric membrane canopies are the primary recommended shade shelter for residential and commercial vehicle parking in tropical climates.
- **What smart parking options does Archzona supply?**: 2-level & 3-level hydraulic stackers, automated matrix puzzle parking, and EV charging shelters.
